Artifacts: (1) WATER MEMORY (rail had 0 validations) — 2026-09-22-water-memory-benveniste-1988-nature-investigation.md: the 1988 Nature investigation that dossier 028 has cited in one line since 09-20 and for which no record existed. Maddox + Walter Stewart + James Randi went to Benveniste's INSERM lab; SEVEN attempts at the basophil-degranulation assay; 3 of the first 4 came out favourable to Benveniste and were refused as unrigorous; Benveniste then INVITED the team to write a stricter protocol — randomized samples, codes wrapped in foil by Randi and taped to the ceiling, objections solicited before unblinding, none raised — and THE THREE BLIND ATTEMPTS WERE NEGATIVE. Nature 334:287 (28 Jul 1988); no fraud alleged; stated mechanism = unintentional observer bias (non-blind replicate readings agreed more closely than chance). Both sides' COI printed in the same report (two of Benveniste's colleagues paid by a homeopathic supplier; the same firm paid the investigators' hotel bill). Recorded with the full 1988-2006 ladder so it cannot be read as one bad week: Hirst et al. Nature 366:525 (1993) independent negative; Belon/Ennis Inflammation Research 48:17 (1999) positive on a different assay; BBC Horizon 2002 null on that claim; DARPA-requested 2001 US DoD test using BENVENISTE'S OWN MACHINE -> FASEB J. 20(1):23 (2006) 'Our team found no replicable effects from digital signals', with positives appearing ONLY when one particular Benveniste researcher ran the rig. (2) RADIESTHESIA-DISCRIMINATION — 2026-09-22-radiesthesia-argenton-2007-observatoire-zetetique.md: the missing mid-rung of the French rail. Observatoire Zetique, Argenton-sur-Creuse 17-18 Mar 2007; a dowser community's own reports put a 'poltergeist' wrench sample above 20,000 Bovis; OZ built 10 numbered boxes / 9 mass-matched distractors / sealed custody / a 1% criterion fixed BEFORE any trial, and let the practitioners set their own conditions (separation distance, instrument, and in one series the practitioner's OWN supplied sample). THREE SERIES, ALL CHANCE: 1/7 (threshold 4), 2/10 (5), 4/32 (9). Protocol verified live this run from the primary (zetetique.fr, FR + EN). Honest limits recorded: small trials, and Chapot's fair critique that OZ never documented its randomization mechanism. (3) RADIESTHESIA-SORTING — 2026-09-22-radiesthesia-pouchet-1934-lyon-blind-packet.md: the tradition recording its OWN miss, from inside. Lyon Linnean Society mushroom exhibition 1934 (Pouchet 1935, FAL-fr-143-5): a pendulum demonstrator PASSED two species he already knew, then scored 0/4 on a blind packet test — Amanita phalloides read 'indifferent', an edible Cortinarius read 'toxic', retreating to 'perhaps edible for you, bad for my stomach'; Pouchet then published Mauguin's full Mycophage protocol (zinc-copper discs, horseshoe magnet, 13-80cm giration spectrum, 14cm vs 1cm inversion) and proposed a blinded commission THAT NEVER MET. Confidence medium — single secondary account read through the corpus translation record, n=4, primary not read this run. (4) DOSSIER 032 — Bovis Scale Calibration: tests THE TRADITION'S OWN RULER, which is a dossier gap the Yard had. Dossier 005 tests inter-rater agreement, 026 hit rate, 029 psi-track, 011 field length — none tests the numeric readout itself. Three arms, ~$0-30, straw: (A) the tradition's OWN anchor, the horseshoe-magnet pole-flip, 20 blind trials (>=15/20, p~0.021); (B) matched-pair ranking against directions THE TRADITION supplies; (C) THE DIAL-SWAP — read the same blind sample against the standard dial and against a silently x2-rescaled dial and compute the ratio R. R~1 means the number tracks something; R~2 means the number tracks the document, which is the corpus's own stated mechanism ('re-label the ruler and the pendulum will adapt itself') caught in the act. This speaks directly to the documented 2014 Bovis re-scale (human baseline 6,500 -> 12,500 UB with NO instrument change; dials to 120,000; Earth at 2.39M and climbing; ACMOS itself calls a 400,000 UB goji reading 'totalement loufoque'). Explicitly names the most interesting outcome (A+B pass, C fails) and forbids interpreting it in the same document.
